title: Coupons — Bay Area Verified Product Coupons
description: Product-only coupon, rebate and BOGO directory for the San Francisco Bay Area, re-scoped on 2026-09-22 to drop event tickets and museum admissions (49 venue-admission entries moved to archive/rescoped-2026-09-22/ with their reasoning, per the dataset's own scope_history). State read from the repository's own generated data/coupons.json at commit 7a130e1 (built_at 2026-09-22T23:43:31Z): 227 verified offers, 20 documented rejections, 265 citations across 72 distinct source domains, verification levels A 190 / B 34 / C 3, and 613 irregularity flags (20 critical, 497 warning, 96 info). Offers live in 15 curated JSON shards under data/entries/ — the largest, 01-pg-brandsaver.json, holding 112 transcribed P&G brandSAVER coupons — and carry 13 deal types. Sourcing is enforced by the build, not by convention: an aggregator, promo-code site, listicle or social domain cited as the source of an available offer fails the build, as does a citation with no verbatim evidence passage, publisher, access date and retrieval method. Expiry status is computed in the browser against the visitor's own date (Active to Expires soon at 7 days or fewer, to Expired, plus Window closed and Not redeemable yet), and every dated record carries a project-side recheck_due date set to the printed expiry minus a 3-day safety margin, which a weekly CI job uses to file re-verification issues before an offer goes stale. The suite now reports 56 tests (53 at the previous read), executed here with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: Ran 56 tests, OK.

flags: Test-count discrepancy: README.md and docs/METHODOLOGY.md both say '50 tests', but `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` executed in this audit at commit 84c8b5c collected and passed 53. The counted value 53 is what this entry publishes and the disagreement is registered as IRR-73 rather than resolved by picking one.

The README's category table (113 manufacturer-digital, 16 restaurant-loyalty, 14 local-independent, 13 bogo-multi-buy, 13 manufacturer-printable, 12 no-spend-free and so on) sums to 213 across 185 offers because categories are multi-valued tags, not a partition: data/coupons.json's own stats.entries_by_category reproduces exactly those numbers. Do not read the table as summing to the offer count.

Freshness is bounded and the repository says so itself: the 112 P&G brandSAVER coupons carried printed expiries of 26-28 September 2026 and the site retires them automatically from those dates, while on the fifth research pass kellanovaus.com intermittently served its coupon grid unpopulated to a plain fetch, so its 8 printables could not be re-confirmed in that cycle — flagged by the repository rather than treated as retracted.

Personalised programmes (Safeway for U, Target Circle, Costco Instant Savings, restaurant apps) are verified at programme level only because their offers are per-account and cannot be read anonymously, and no Facebook or Instagram post was read or cited at all: both require authentication, so social platforms generated leads that were then verified on an official domain or rejected.
